_comment: Hand-curated layer of docs/capabilities.json. The emitter (stapel_inventory/_capabilities.py) merges this over the derived axes; an axis in conf.py DEFAULTS marked as an axis but missing here (or vice versa) is a loud emission error. surface_roots + surface are the usage layer: every public function of the selected modules carries an intent line here.
provides: Stock per location for opaque purchasables (the orders purchasable pair), an append-only movement ledger whose sum is on_hand, and checkout holds with a TTL. Plugs into stapel-orders as a checkout hook (reserve / commit / release, idempotent on the checkout attempt key): a reserve locks the stock rows in ascending id order and re-counts availability under the lock, all-or-nothing across lines, so two shoppers racing for the last unit end as one order and one error.409.insufficient_stock. Allocation across locations is a strategy (single_default, priority); oversell is an axis (deny, backorder) with a per-item override; untracked purchasables pass through. A public availability endpoint discloses in-stock / few-left / out-of-stock per a policy; staff receive, adjust with a reason, transfer and import CSV. Low-stock, out-of-stock, back-in-stock and oversold facts fire once per transition. Beat tasks expire holds of crashed checkouts and reconcile the cache with the ledger.

requires.reason: comm bus (inventory.* facts, availability and checkout hook Functions, user.merged consumer), AnchorPagination, GDPR owner protocol, AppSettings
calls the checkout hooks registered by stapel_inventory.preset.SETTINGS_DEFAULTS; without it the stock API, availability and facts still work
a guest checkout's hold is keyed on a stapel-auth anonymous account; user.merged moves it to the account

extension_points.name: ALLOCATION
extension_points.summary: Which locations a reserve takes stock from: single_default (default; only the default location sells), priority (active locations by priority, a line may split), a register_allocation name, or a dotted path to an AllocationStrategy. The strategy is pure: it sees the locked, counted candidates and answers allocations.

extension_points.name: STAPEL_ORDERS['CHECKOUT_HOOKS']['inventory']
extension_points.summary: The orders checkout hook entry shipped in stapel_inventory.preset.SETTINGS_DEFAULTS: reserve / commit / release Function names and order 50 (stock first: before promotions 100 and delivery 200). Merge it under the project's STAPEL_ORDERS; nothing else wires stock into checkout.

extension_points.name: STAPEL_INVENTORY_AVAILABILITY_PRESENTER / STAPEL_INVENTORY_STOCK_PRESENTER
extension_points.summary: Swap keys (STAPEL_SWAP) for the public availability presenter (where the disclosure policy is applied) and the staff stock/ledger presenter.

extension_points.name: inventory.availability
extension_points.summary: Exact availability for a keyed batch of one purchasable type (on_hand, held, available, policy, per location) for a listing page or another module; the public endpoint applies PUBLIC_AVAILABILITY on top.

extension_points.name: inventory.stock.low / inventory.stock.out / inventory.stock.back_in_stock
extension_points.summary: Emitted once per alert-state transition of a stock item (never per sale), in the transaction of the movement that caused it; a back-in-stock notification is a host subscriber.

extension_points.name: inventory.stock.oversold
extension_points.summary: A commit drove a deny item below zero because its hold had expired before the order's commit arrived; the order is the fact and staff must act.

ALLOCATION.summary: single_default (default): only the default location's stock is sold; other locations are storage you transfer from. priority: every active location sells, highest priority first, and one order line may be split across locations. Values: single_default, priority.
ALLOCATION.behavior: single_default: availability and reserves count the default location only; priority: they count every active location ordered by priority.

OVERSELL.summary: deny (default): checkout refuses more units than are available. backorder: the order goes through and the missing units are backordered (stock goes negative). A single item can override it. Values: deny, backorder.
OVERSELL.behavior: deny: reserve answers error.409.insufficient_stock; backorder: the remainder is held as backordered and on_hand goes negative on commit.

TRACK_UNKNOWN.summary: allow (default): a product with no stock record is not stock-managed and always sells. deny: it cannot be sold until stock is recorded. Values: allow, deny.
TRACK_UNKNOWN.behavior: allow: no hold line, never blocked; deny: reserve answers error.409.stock_not_tracked.

PUBLIC_AVAILABILITY.summary: few_left (default): in stock, a few left, out of stock or on backorder, never a number. exact: the number of units too. in_stock: only in or out of stock. Values: few_left, exact, in_stock.
PUBLIC_AVAILABILITY.behavior: The public availability endpoint answers state (and quantity only under exact); the internal Function always answers numbers.

RESTOCK_ON_CANCEL.summary: true (default): when an order is cancelled its units go back on the shelf. false: staff return them by hand. Values: true, false.
RESTOCK_ON_CANCEL.behavior: true: release with reason cancelled on a committed hold writes a restock movement; false: it is a no-op.

MAX_AVAILABILITY_KEYS.summary: How many keys one availability request (GET availability/ or the inventory.availability Function) may ask for; more is refused with error.400.availability_too_many_keys, whose params.max carries this limit. A client pages its keys by it.

register_allocation.intent: Register an allocation strategy under a short name ALLOCATION (and the environment) may choose; call it from an AppConfig.ready().

reset_allocations.intent: Drop runtime registrations — a test lever.

allocation_names.intent: The short names ALLOCATION accepts (built-ins plus registered); also the env vocabulary.

resolve_allocation.intent: Turn an ALLOCATION value (short name or dotted path) into a strategy instance; raises ImproperlyConfigured (check E001) for an unknown name.

active_allocation.intent: The strategy the current settings select; ask it instead of reading the setting.
